resources.string: Unable to play this media file
Player error: %1$s. Retry or select another image/video.
Press Back or Menu on the remote during playback to open settings
Start playback after the TV boots
Some TVs also require Auto-start and Background activity permissions in system settings.
Fit shows the full image; Crop to fill removes black bars.
Each still image advances after the selected duration; videos advance when playback finishes. Press OK to cycle through 5, 10, 15, 30, or 60 seconds.
Remote tip: press Back, Menu, or Settings on the playback screen to return here.
Video supports common containers such as MP4, MKV, WebM, and MPEG-TS. Images support JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, and HEIF/HEIC; AVIF requires Android 14+. Animated GIF is not supported.
No supported images or videos were selected. Please try again.
The system picker did not grant persistent read access. Use the built-in media library or select the files again.
This TV has no compatible system file picker. Use the built-in media library.
USB mode only plays images and videos inside the TVAutoPlayer folder at the USB root. Add media files, then reinsert the drive.
Media on the USB drive was moved or deleted. Reinsert the drive.
Add images / videos from TV / USB
You will be asked to select media again next time. The original images and videos will not be deleted.
Added %1$d media files. %2$d files were unsupported, unreadable, or could not receive persistent access.
Scans system-recognized images and videos in internal storage and mounted USB drives. Move with Up/Down and press OK to select multiple files in playback order.
Scanning images and videos on the TV and USB drives…
Found %1$d supported media files. Select files and save.
No supported images or videos were found. Copy files to Movies/TVAutoPlay or Pictures/TVAutoPlay on the TV or USB drive, reconnect the drive, wait briefly, then select Rescan.
Scan failed. Check image/video read permission and the USB connection, then try again.
Photo and video read permission is required to read media from the USB drive. Allow photo and video access for this app in system settings, then return.
Select at least one image or video.
No scheduled playlist is active now. Playback will start automatically when the next enabled window begins, or you can add a default playlist in Settings.
No scheduled playlists have been configured.
Assign an independent image/video playlist to each time window. The player switches within about 30 seconds of a boundary. Unscheduled time uses the default playlist.
No time windows yet. Select Add time window, then choose its start, end, and media.
Only the schedule rules are removed. Original images and videos on the TV or USB drive are not deleted.
Time uses 30-minute increments. Enabled time windows cannot overlap other enabled windows.
An end time earlier than the start crosses midnight, for example 22:00–06:00.
Select at least one image or video for this time window.
Start and end times must be different.
This window overlaps %1$s. Adjust the time or disable one of the windows.
The schedule rule is removed. Original images and videos are not deleted.
Server mode (content controlled by the CMS)
Enter server IP or domain (for example 192.168.2.100). No http:// prefix needed.
Current mode: USB playback (only the TVAutoPlayer folder at the USB root)
Connected to remote server v%1$d · last update %2$s ago
Remote mode is on, but not connected to the server yet
Set the server address before enabling remote mode.
No playable content on the server yet. Upload media and add it to the program in the admin UI first.
The server has no playable media yet. Upload media and add it to the program in the admin UI first.
Server mode lets the CMS control content, order, and schedules. USB mode plays only images and videos inside the TVAutoPlayer folder at the USB root, sorted by file name and looped.
Set the server address before switching to server mode.
USB folder not found: put files in the TVAutoPlayer folder at the USB root.
No media found in USB mode. Put images or videos into the TVAutoPlayer folder at the USB root; playback starts automatically after the drive is reinserted.
The server program is empty. Add media to the default program in the admin console; if only schedules are configured, playback starts automatically when a schedule begins.
Applied automatically on each new video. Auto prefers the system language track; or pick a specific track number.
